outcome: Equip is activated only at sorcery speed targeting a creature its controller controls, and attaches the Equipment to that creature on resolution.
An Equip [quality] ability can target only a creature its controller controls with that quality, but the Equipment stays attached if the creature later loses the quality.
Each of a permanent's equip abilities can be activated on its own.
Equip planeswalker targets only a planeswalker its controller controls and attaches the Equipment to it.
